title: Payback trade-offs from the electrolyte design between energy efficiency and lifespan in zinc-ion batteries
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, 18,13-18
DOI: 10.1039/D4EE03483J, Opinion
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Xuan Gao, Haobo Dong, Chang Su, Yuhang Dai, Yiyang Liu, Ivan P. Parkin, Claire J. Carmalt, Guanjie He
The payback period is a critical indicator when adopting energy storage systems. When developing optimization strategies for emerging energy storage technologies such as aqueous zinc-ion batteries, their economic feasibility should be considered.
